remarks: Located in the heart of downtown, this renovated & freshly painted 2-bedroom, 2-bath corner unit offers a spacious, contemporary layout with an open, airy design. The generously sized living room flows seamlessly into the dining area, all while showcasing stunning city views. The kitchen is equipped with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and gas cooking. Both bedrooms are spacious, with the primary suite featuring a custom walk-in closet, and updated bathrooms with a zen-like design. Heat, hot water, and gas are included, along with off-street parking for two vehicles. Enjoy the convenience of walking distance to Metro-North for easy access to NYC, as well as parks, nightlife, shopping, and more!
